title: Server administration
intro: Review the environment and accounts, then explicitly choose the actions you need.
boundary: Server administrators still need separate page permissions to read page content.
readonly: Environment settings are read-only. Apply changes through environment variables.
userListHint: Shows up to 100 users. Workspace permissions are managed separately.
moreUsers: The display limit of 100 users has been reached.
selectUser: Choose a user to review their sessions.
revokeHint: The user will need to sign in again to use this session.
revokeCurrent: This is your current session. Revoking it also requires you to sign in again here.
currentRevoked: Your current session was revoked. Please sign in again.
queueNote: “Service accepted” means only that the sending service accepted the submission. Delivery and receipt are not verified.
testHint: Only your current verified email is used. Custom content and other recipients cannot be supplied.
testConsent: I request a test email to my own address
testQueued: Test email queued. Delivery has not been verified.
testReplay: The existing test job was found. No new job was created.
mailDisabled: Email sending is disabled. Configure it through environment variables to request a test.
retryHint: Returns the same test job to the queue, addressed to your current verified email.
retryQueued: Test job returned to the queue.
remaining: Account suspension, deletion and MFA administration are not available on this screen yet.
denied: This screen is available only to verified server administrators explicitly listed in the environment.
accessChanged: Authority or the target changed. Actions are paused. Reload to review the current state.
accountChanged: Your account changed. Actions are paused. Reload and confirm which account to use.
unavailable: The action could not be completed. Check the connection and try again.
uncertain: The registration result could not be confirmed. Refresh jobs to review their state. Your input is preserved.
conflict: The job state changed. Refresh to review its current state.
invalidResponse: The response could not be verified. Displayed information has not been updated.
moreSessions: The display limit of 100 sessions has been reached.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
